info.name: UBHR Recruitment Portal - existing-table lean D365 service
info.description: Three POST custom-service operations on the existing UBHR_Nive model tables. All examples are fictional. Configure an F&O development environment and an Entra resource token locally. ApplicationId is generated and frozen by the backend SQLite record before submission; D365 must preserve it. EvaluationId is EVA- plus the same GUID. This collection verifies only core F&O persistence, not SQLite history, resume upload or a real AI review. No resume references, hashes, consent, profile JSON or model audit metadata are sent to D365. Use the React portal with real uploads to test the complete workflow. Never export a token or client secret.

    "Company": "{{company}}",
    "EvaluationId": "{{evaluationId}}",

    "MissingSkillsJson": "[{\"Requirement\":\"Azure DevOps delivery experience\",\"Reason\":\"No Azure DevOps delivery example is present in the illustrative resume.\"}]",

request.description: Fictional core-persistence contract test against the existing tables. Technical metadata is maintained by the backend in SQLite; this direct request does not create a SQLite row or upload a resume.

exec: if (!/^APP-[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$/.test(appId || '')) { throw new Error('Set a stable APP-<GUID> applicationId before submission.'); }
if (pm.collectionVariables.get('evaluationId') !== 'EVA-' + appId.slice(4)) { throw new Error('evaluationId must be EVA- plus the same frozen application GUID.'); }

pm.test('Evaluation belongs to submitted candidate', function () { const candidateId = pm.collectionVariables.get('candidateId'); if (candidateId) { pm.expect(result.CandidateId).to.equal(candidateId); } });
